d:
恶戏的动画很多人都看过，但没多少人玩过游戏，更别说解包看CG了。我在巧合下找到并下载了一个2005年的压缩包，于是便有了这个图库。我大概是全网第一个解包恶戏的人吧。顺带一提，这游戏是1996年的，可能比你大哦。
Many people have watched the anime adaptation of Itazura (悪戯), but very few have actually played the original game, let alone unpacked it to view the CGs. By chance, I found and downloaded a 2005 compressed package, which allowed me to create this gallery. I might be the first person on the Internet to unpack Itazura.By the way, this game is from 1996 — it might even be older than you.
n: [Game CG] 恶戏游戏CG丨G-Spot Express（Itazura） Game CG
